resources.string: Lift a subject out of a photo in one step. The subject stays sharp, the edges stay soft, and nothing is uploaded: the model runs on this phone.

Every model is openly licensed and credited in its details. Bundled licence texts ship in the app assets. No model is used without a visible attribution.
Portraits and single subjects work best. Decoding, cut-out and saving all happen on this device.
Background removal needs an installed model.
Transparent cut-outs are saved as PNG with a real alpha channel.
This backdrop is saved as a high-quality JPEG.
Open it now to check the edges and backdrop, or share it anywhere.
The default model. Small, quick, and best for one person in a portrait photo.
The same quick cutout, tuned for wide or landscape photos.
Separates hair, skin, and clothes for cleaner edges. A larger download.
Masks hair on its own, for recolouring or softer edges.
Recognises pets, products, furniture and vehicles as well as people. Best for photos whose subject is not a person.
Soft hair and edge detail for cleaner portrait cut-outs. A 25 MB download; best for people, not general objects.

Models run entirely on this device. Bundled models are copied out of the app on first use and checked against their checksum; downloaded models are verified the same way and only replace the old file after they match. The network is used only when you start a download.
Model downloads are the only time AI Lab uses the network.
